title: Harness opus-budget-guard: Opus over target -> delegate
desc: Blocks an Opus Agent dispatch when Opus total or monthly budget is exceeded; the correct response is to route the work to a cheaper model via Agent.cmd, not to wait.
steps: TRIGGER: fires on an Opus Agent/Agent.cmd dispatch when Get-ClaudePaceInfo shows total or monthly exceeded for the Opus family.
FIX: Agent.cmd --model haiku (or sonnet) for the actual execution; reserve Opus for judgment/synthesis only. Over-pace is NOT a stop -- delegate real work to gate-exempt cheaper agents.

WHY: Opus is the scarce judgment tier; burning it on execution at budget cap wastes the reserve. See: opus-over-pace-is-not-a-stop-delegate-real-work-to-gate-exempt-haiku-codex-agents, claude-code-agent-tier-routing.
author: claude
